limits: Source roots are the explicit recipe scope, not the complete transitive external build-input closure. Registry/git dependency source trees, global Cargo config/environment, linker and wrapper binaries are not separately captured by this recipe. Cargo.lock and actual preserved executable bytes are bound.
Enabled feature lists name selected daemon, Bybit, engine and sinks packages; they are not a whole third-party feature-resolution graph.

The executable fingerprint observes the preserved current_exe path file. Length/mtime checks detect ordinary replacement/change, not hostile same-metadata substitution, OS loaded-image equivalence, signed attestation, or reproducible-build proof.

Exact literal containment establishes the observed retained binary contains these recipe bytes; it does not alone prove historical execution or code reachability. The source uses include_str! for this exact generated recipe.
Operational commit/release/replay/live loop, live source freshness and universal data coverage are outside this receipt.
